department: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by December 15, 2026 (8:59 pm Pacific); transcripts and letters accepted up to 2 weeks later but may not be reviewed.
deadline.quote: The deadline for the 2027-28 academic year is December 15, 2026 at 20:59pm PST.

gre_general.value: CEE neither requires nor accepts the GRE.
gre_general.quote: CEE department no longer requires, nor accepts, the GRE.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The pages checked do not say whether you need a supervisor before applying.

funding.value: Most departmental funding is reserved for PhD students.
funding.quote: Most funding is reserved for PhD students which means there is limited funding for MS-only students.

entry_route.value: The main route into the PhD is with a master's; applicants without one are considered only exceptionally and must finish an MS in the first two years.
entry_route.quote: The primary pathway into the Civil and Environmental Engineering PhD program involves entering with a master’s degree. Applicants without a master’s degree may apply to the PhD program and will be reviewed on an exceptional basis

notes: Seven CEE programs each have their own prerequisites. Bachelor's-only applicants are encouraged to also select consideration for the Professional MS.
